newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway Elkem reorganises group structure.
newsitem.headline: Norway Elkem reorganises group structure.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Monday it had merged its ferrosilicon and silicon metal divisions to form a single unit known as Silicon Division.
"The ferrosilicon and silicon metals operations are gradually becoming more similar as regards production and technology and raw material supplies," the company said in a statement.

It added that in order to consolidate the group's international business development, espcially in the fields of carbon products and microsilica, it would merge parts of Elkem International with its carbon/materials division to form Materials and Development.
Elkem International has been split into three units -- Elkem logistics, sales and representative officies in Europe and group procurement.

Other Elkem International units -- Elkem chartering, sales and representative offices outside Europe and purchasing services for coal and coke -- will transfer to the materials and development division.
